offering_description.value: Provides wealth management technology platforms, investment processing and operations outsourcing, and investment management services. Clients include banks, trust companies, wealth advisors, asset managers and institutional investors. Delivers through cloud-based software, outsourced operations and managed portfolios.

primary_products.value: wealth management software platform; investment processing software; mutual funds and managed portfolios

primary_services.value: investment operations outsourcing; investment management; asset administration and processing; advisor consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, trust institutions, wealth managers, financial advisors, asset managers; B2C: high-net-worth individuals and families served via advisors and private banks

end_markets.value: banking; wealth management; asset management; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring platform and technology fees from banks and advisors; commissions or management fees: asset-based fees on managed investments and funds; service fees: outsourced processing and operations services
revenue_model.category: subscription; commissions or management fees; service fees
